files.text: Part 2. In this part, you will see a picture and three questions about it. You have one minute to prepare your answers, and then two minutes to answer all three questions. Start speaking when you hear this sound.

Part 3. In this part, you will see a statement and two lists of points: points for it, and points against it. Choose two points from each list, and speak about both sides. You have one minute to prepare, and then two minutes to speak. Start speaking when you hear this sound.
